recordId.title: Record Id
recordId.description: Id of the record to read.

fields.title: Fields
fields.description: Optional. Field API names to read, comma-separated, for example "Status, Priority, Subject". Leave blank for all fields.

agentId.title: Agent Id
agentId.description: Your agent identifier. Use the same value in every AgentLedger action.

reasoning.title: Reasoning
reasoning.description: Optional. Why you are looking at this record.

sessionId.title: Session Id
sessionId.description: Optional. Leave blank: your open AgentLedger run is used, or a new one is started.
